## Find the reports folder

Find the `reports/` folder in your HALFpipe working directory after [checking that processing completed](../check_run.qmd). You'll use these files during QC.

| File | What you use it for |
|---|---|
| `reportpreproc.txt` | Check which outputs are marked `done` or `missing`. |
| `index.html` | Open the browser report to inspect images and record ratings. |
| `reportvals.txt` | Look up numerical QC measures, such as mean framewise displacement (FD) and mean grey matter temporal signal-to-noise ratio (tSNR). |

::: {.callout-tip title="Reviewing on another computer"}
Copy the entire `reports/` folder, including the subject folders and supporting files. The browser report needs those files to display its images.
:::

## Open the summary report {#step-1-open-the-summary-report-in-the-reports-folder}

Open `reports/reportpreproc.txt` in a text editor. The example below shows how the report lists processing status.

| Subject | Task | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | rest | done |
| 2 | rest | missing |
| 3 | rest | missing |
| 4 | rest | done |

**Done** indicates that processing produced the expected outputs. Inspect their quality in the browser report. **Missing** indicates that an expected output is absent. Use section 3 to investigate the processing issue.

## Check for missing outputs {#step-1.1-check-for-missing-files-in-the-summary-report}

<span id="tabset-1-1"></span>

**All expected outputs are present.** Continue to [4.3 Rate the reports](reports.qmd).

<span id="tabset-1-2"></span>
<span id="step-1.1.1-re-run-missing-or-failed-subjects"></span>

**Some expected outputs are missing.** Use [section 3 to check preprocessing](../check_run.qmd#check-preprocessing-outputs) and [rerun HALFpipe if needed](../check_run.qmd#rerun-halfpipe). Once the expected outputs are present, [open the QC report](reports.qmd).
<!-- qc-source-end -->
